rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something at or near the rear, such as a back door.

example.english: Is the back door locked yet?
example.jyutping: hau6 mun4 so2 zo2 mei6 aa3

rows.note: Use 返 as the all-purpose choice when something is returned or an action is done in return.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 faan1 lei4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the rear or farthest-back part of a place or object.

example.english: There's a small storeroom at the back of the shop.
example.jyutping: dim3 pou3 hau6 min6 jau5 go3 sai3 cong1

rows.note: Use this when “back” means remote or away from the main areas, especially of a road or place.

example.english: That place is too far back from the main areas, so don't go there alone at night.
example.traditional: 嗰度太偏僻，夜晚唔好自己去。
example.jyutping: go2 dou6 taai3 pin1 pik1 je6 maan5 m4 hou2 zi6 gei2 heoi3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for backing or supporting a person, cause, or decision.

example.english: I back your decision this time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 caang1 nei5 gam1 ci3 ge3 kyut3 ding6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the back of a person's body.

example.english: My back has been hurting all day.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bui3 zek3 tung3 zo2 seng4 jat6

rows.note: Use 向後 for movement or orientation in the reverse direction, including moving farther toward the back or receding.

example.jyutping: bou6 ce1 dat6 jin4 hoeng3 hau6 lau6

rows.note: Use this when a person or non-vehicle moves backward; use 倒車 for reversing a vehicle.

example.english: Back up a little so I can get through.
example.traditional: 你退後少少，等我行過去。
example.jyutping: nei5 teoi3 hau6 siu2 siu2 dang2 ngo5 haang4 gwo3 heoi3

rows.note: Use this specifically when a vehicle reverses or backs into a place.

example.english: Back the car into the space first.
example.jyutping: nei5 dou2 ce1 jap6 go3 wai2 sin1

rows.note: Use 以前 when back refers to an earlier time or a time ago.

example.english: I used to live in this area back then.
example.jyutping: ji5 cin4 ngo5 zyu6 hai2 ni1 keoi1

rows.note: Use this for the back-facing surface of an object or the back panel of clothing, rather than a rear location.

example.english: The back of the card has my phone number.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 kaat1 bui3 min6 jau5 ngo5 din6 waa2

rows.note: Use this construction when physically pushing or forcing A backward, especially an object or animal.

example.english: I pushed the table back to make room for the air conditioner.
example.traditional: 我推張枱向後，畀部冷氣騰位。
example.jyutping: ngo5 teoi1 zoeng1 toi2 hoeng3 hau6 bei2 bou6 laang5 hei3 tang4 wai2

rows.note: Use 離遠啲 when telling someone to keep farther away rather than specifically move backward.

example.english: Back off and stay farther away from me.
example.jyutping: nei5 tung4 ngo5 lei4 jyun5 di1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the backrest of a chair.

example.english: The back of this chair is broken.
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 ji2 ge3 ji2 bui3 laan6 zo2
